wrc9.title: WRC 9 live pacenotes
wrc9.privilegeWarning: Run ZTMZ and WRC 9 at the same Windows privilege level, preferably both as a normal user.
wrc9.limitations: Experimental single-player support for the verified Steam build. Original game speech remains enabled. Basic vehicle telemetry and live calls are available. Some directional calls and advanced telemetry are not yet mapped.
wrc9.warning: This experimental feature injects a DLL into WRC 9 and may affect game stability. Use offline. It remains loaded until the game exits. Continue?
wrc9.windowsOnly: The WRC 9 live bridge currently supports Windows only.
